notes.title: Levels of difficulty
notes.content:
[h3]We've added a difficulty setting to the game![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326641/3d9cbf71de77768250f5f72ea547e4f1101187d8.png[/img]
[b]There are three types of difficulty - Casual, Classic, Hardcore![/b].
The difficulty affects the health of monsters, how often they attack in melee, and the prices in the shop. 
You can change the game's difficulty at any time.
Also in this update we have tweaked the code and increased the performance of the game on weak computers, as well as fixed a rare bug with gamepad freezing.

notes.title: New languages - Chinese, German, Spanish! Camera up!
notes.content:
[h3]Added 3 languages to the game: Spanish, German and Chinese.[/h3]

[u]Improvements:[/u]
- Code optimization was performed, the game became more stable.
- The camera is raised above the playing field by 20%.
- Added a link to Discord

[u]Bugfixes:[/u]
- Geronimo will not get mutoken if he loses if there is a skill Service
- In the Crocodile Tears level, it is now possible to leave the level through the house using the gamepad.
- The shadows in the Crocodile Tears level have been fixed.
- The capsule in the Crocodile Tears level now does not create an alien egg on the pyramid.
- In the Small World level, Roland's fireworks and springs are sized to match the size of the machine.

notes.title: Results of the week
notes.content:
[b]This is Illegal Turtle🐢[/b]

Dear players!
During this week we have received feedback from you! Your wishes and feedback are very valuable to us!
We are closely following your adventures in SSS, and we will try to further improve and refine the game, so that the experience of being on the station will give you maximum pleasure.

[u]List of changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added image sharpness setting.
[*] Added image gamma setting.
[*] Improved performance in the store.
[*] Now, during a pause, the title and text of the script are displayed in the upper left corner.
[*] If the machines are not yet open, the scenario menu shows that the machines are not available.
[*] It also shows which script they will be opened from.
[*] Holographic key "rain" will spawn more candies
[*] Changed the balance of the scenario "Black Hydras"
[*] Axe strengthened
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326641/007bce70e3430d6dc4ec3c5ef66383531deaa041.png[/img]

notes.title: Final Preparations
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QdK8-agCfzQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]This is Illegal Turtle team![/h3]
We've prepared a new trailer, and we want to share it with you! 
The last weeks before release we've been busy tweaking inaccuracies, as well as customizing achievements and gamepads.
Back to the difficulty questions. It seems that the game turned out to be challenging, but we hope that this will not scare you off and you will meet the challenge with excitement.
And if it turns out to be not too difficult, we still want to make SSS+ mode, which is similar to NG+ in the Dark Souls series.
We've finalized the release date for the game, and we're happy to announce that the game will go into Early Access on March 1.
Add Sunset Survival Station to your wishlist so you don't miss the game's release date.

notes.title: Let's Go! Sunset Survival Station - news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326641/2cbd40e86f9edcaff6543b848e1c10d80fdfe2ac.png[/img]
[h3]Illegal Turtle team here![/h3]
We've been working hard all this year, and now we're in the homestretch towards early release!
The game's release is just around the corner, and we wanted to give you a little insight into the final months before Sunset Survival Station goes into early access.
During this time, we came up with a couple of cool new mechanics, and the game has undergone some conceptual changes!

[h3]Scenarios[/h3]
Now there are not only 4 zones in the game, but 20 unique scenarios in which the player has to survive. We approach each scenario as a separate little game! 
This has allowed us to move a bit away from complete randomization of events, but each scenario requires careful testing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326641/ad92af4c9432a4c50ed1034737bb5eb67c4b8592.png[/img]

[h3]Heroes[/h3]
We decided not to chase quantity, but to rely on quality!
There will be 3 heroes on release, but each of them will have 36 unique skills, which will emphasize the peculiarities of each hero's combat style. It is not certain that we will have time to balance all the skills, so we hope for your feedback  )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326641/608093aec0faec9a3adcf9225d713a2d9e32edd3.png[/img]

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
We have debates about how difficult a game should be.
In the days of Dark Souls' rampage, everyone wanted to overcome. Vampire Survivors, in our opinion, is too slow and calm. We're trying to find a balance!

Let us know what else you would like to know about the game!
And write to us how difficult you would like to see the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326641/2368bf102db49fa5df2127f056b017664e47e94a.png[/img]
